description: This file defines a composable UI component called HomeCard for an Android TV application. It provides two variants: a default poster card and a TV channel card, each with detailed layout and styling, including focus handling, images or placeholders, progress bars, badges, and icons. It leverages Jetpack Compose for declarative UI.

classes.name: HomeCardVariant
classes.description: Enum representing the presentation variant of the HomeCard: Default or TV Channel.

methods.name: HomeCard
methods.description: Main composable function that renders a card in either the Default or TV Channel variant based on parameters.

methods.name: DefaultPosterCard
methods.description: Composable that renders a default poster style card with an image, title, and progress bar.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Composable that renders a TV channel style card with poster, info text, badges, progress, and optional channel icon.
